gamification.title: Points and challenges
gamification.subtitle: Define how much each action is worth, which levels exist and which challenges are open.

challenges.newDescription: It starts as a draft. Open it when you want the community to see it.
challenges.descPlaceholder: Explain the challenge and what proof you expect to receive.
challenges.proofCheckbox: Require proof (screenshot, file or link) to be able to submit
challenges.emptyTitle: You have not created any challenges yet
challenges.emptyHint: The one that usually works first: ask people to document and publish their success story.

submissions.emptyHint: Submissions appear here as soon as someone completes a challenge.

levels.newDescription: Levels are reached with lifetime accumulated points, which never reset.
levels.namePlaceholder: What you want to call it
levels.benefitPlaceholder: What those who get here take away.
levels.emptyTitle: You have not defined any levels yet
levels.emptyHint: Until you create the first one, nobody has a level: points accumulate all the same.

perks.needLevelHint: A perk hangs from a level: it is what must be reached to unlock it.
perks.newDescription: What a level unlocks: a 1:1 session, an extra class, a tailored lesson… It is not granted automatically — the student requests it and you fulfill it.
perks.descPlaceholder: What it includes and how it is organized.
perks.emptyHint: Without perks, a level is just a name.

requests.emptyPendingHint: Perk requests land here as soon as someone sends them.
requests.emptyApprovedHint: What you approve stays here until you mark it as done.
requests.emptyClosedHint: Requests already fulfilled or rejected end up here.

rules.title: How much each action is worth
rules.description: The daily cap limits how many times a day the same action scores: it is what prevents racking up points by posting for the sake of posting. Zero means no limit.
rules.backfillDescription: Awards points for activity prior to the points system, with its original date. It can be repeated safely: nothing gets duplicated.
rules.backfillDone: Done: {awarded} new entry(ies) from {posts} post(s), {comments} comment(s), {resources} resource(s), {courses} completed course(s) and {referrals} referral(s).

spaces.noAccess: Only tenant administrators can manage community spaces.
spaces.title: Community spaces
spaces.subtitle: Create, edit and reorder the spaces shown in the sidebar. System spaces (marked with 🔒) cannot be deleted.
spaces.emptyList: No spaces yet. Create the first one.
spaces.formEditDescription: The slug cannot be changed. Edit the remaining fields.
spaces.formNewDescription: Create a new space. The slug is permanent once created.
spaces.emojiHint: A single emoji or special character.
spaces.orderHint: Lower number → appears earlier in the sidebar.
spaces.deleteConfirm: Delete the space "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.

tags.noAccess: Only tenant administrators can manage community tags.
tags.title: Community tags
tags.subtitle: Curate the official tags of the tenant with color and icon. Authors can still write free-form tags in their posts; the ones curated here are painted with the configured style in the feed and the sidebar.
tags.emptyList: No tags yet. Create the first one in the form on the right.
tags.count: {count, plural, one {{count} curated tag.} other {{count} curated tags.}}
tags.formEditDescription: Edit the name, color or icon. The change affects every post that uses this tag.
tags.formNewDescription: Create an official tag. The name is normalized to lowercase to avoid duplicates.

apiPosts.title: Posts via API
apiPosts.description: Posts created with POST /community-api/posts (API key with community:post scope), grouped by the admin who owns the key. Keys are managed in API keys and the endpoint is documented in API keys → Documentation.
apiPosts.empty: No posts created via API yet.
apiPosts.viaApiKey: Published via an API key of this user.

competencies.title: Competencies
competencies.subtitle: Define the competency catalog and assign competencies to courses. Each student score is computed automatically from their progress in the associated courses.
competencies.catalogDescription: The competencies available in your organization.
competencies.catalogEmpty: No competencies yet. Create the first one above.
competencies.byCourseDescription: Assign competencies to a course along with their weight. The student progress in the course feeds those competencies.
competencies.chooseCourse: Choose a course to assign competencies.
competencies.createFirst: First create competencies in the catalog.
competencies.defineHint: Define which competencies the course covers.

surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.subtitle: Anonymous feedback from the community. The post-class survey is created automatically when each live session ends; here you see the aggregates (NPS, averages) and the free-text answers.
surveys.empty: No surveys yet. They are created automatically when each live class ends.

aiProviders.title: AI providers
aiProviders.subtitle: Configure which AI provider to use for the tutor (chat) and for course indexing (embeddings). The API key is encrypted before being stored and is never shown again.
aiProviders.missingFields: You have to choose a provider and an API key.
aiProviders.deleteConfirm: Delete the {purpose} config? It will fall back to the global default.
aiProviders.reindexConnectionCut: The connection was cut before finishing, but the reindex is still running on the server. Wait a few minutes and ask the tutor something to check it; there is no need to run it again.
aiProviders.noConfigDescription: There is no tenant-specific provider. The cluster default will be used if configured.
aiProviders.apiKeyHint: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM before being persisted. It is never returned to the client.
aiProviders.notesPlaceholder: To remember which billing account this key lives in.
aiProviders.reindexDescription: Courses are indexed automatically when published. If you published courses before configuring the embeddings provider (or indexing failed), use this to reindex ALL published courses at once. Requires the embeddings provider configured above.
aiProviders.reindexCheckQuota: Check that the embeddings provider is active and has quota.

aiTutor.title: AI tutor
aiTutor.subtitle: What your students ask the tutor, what it answers them and what needs correcting. What you correct here is used by the tutor in its next answers, with no reindexing.
